Paper_Metadata.Paper_Title: Phase formation capability and compositional design of β-phase multiple rare-earth principal component disilicates
Paper_Metadata.SI_Data_Note: 论文提到 Supplementary Table 1 含 TEM-EDS mapping 原子比数据，Supplementary Figs. 1-11 含额外 XRD/STEM 数据，但 OCR 文本中不含这些补充数据

Raw_Evidence_Span: All the detected peaks for (Dy0.25Tm0.25Yb0.25Lu0.25)2Si2O7 samples could be indexed to β-Yb2Si2O7 (PDF#25-1345). The homogeneous distribution of the RE elements is further confirmed by the SEM-EDS analysis.
twenty-one four-RE-principal-component (RE0.25RE0.25RE0.25RE0.25)Si2O7 (RE = Y, La, Ce, Eu, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho, Er, Tm, Yb, and Lu) are synthesized

Phase_Composition.Note: Pure single-phase β-type solid solution, indexed to β-Yb2Si2O7 (PDF#25-1345)

Composition.Note: Composition designed according to stoichiometry; homogeneous RE distribution confirmed by SEM-EDS with Dy:Tm:Yb:Lu nearly 1:1:1:1

Process_Text.original: Commercially available powders of rare-earth oxides and SiO2 were mixed according to the stoichiometry of (Dy0.25Tm0.25Yb0.25Lu0.25)2Si2O7, ball milled for 24 h in a Si3N4 jar with Si3N4 balls and ethanol solution, dried at 60 °C for 24 h, passed through a 120-mesh sieve, and then synthesized by pressure-less synthesis at 1550 °C for 6 h.
Process_Text.simplified: RE oxide + SiO2 mixed stoichiometrically, 24 h ball milling in Si3N4 jar/balls with ethanol, dried 60 °C/24 h, 120-mesh sieved, pressure-less synthesis at 1550 °C for 6 h.

Equipment.Instrument_Name: Si3N4 milling jar and Si3N4 balls

Structure_Text.original: All the detected peaks for (Dy0.25Tm0.25Yb0.25Lu0.25)2Si2O7 samples could be indexed to β-Yb2Si2O7 (PDF#25-1345). The homogeneous distribution of the RE elements is further confirmed by SEM-EDS analysis, wherein the atomic ratios of Dy:Tm:Yb:Lu are measured to be nearly 1:1:1:1. The as-synthesized powders are pure single-phase β-(Dy0.25Tm0.25Yb0.25Lu0.25)2Si2O7 solid solutions.
Structure_Text.simplified: Pure single-phase β-type solid solution indexed to β-Yb2Si2O7 (PDF#25-1345) with homogeneous RE distribution (Dy:Tm:Yb:Lu ≈ 1:1:1:1).

Avg_RE3plus_Radius_Angstrom.Note: Calculated as weighted average of RE3+ cationic radii for Dy, Tm, Yb, Lu

RE_Radius_Deviation_sigma_r_Angstrom.Note: Standard deviation of RE3+ cationic radii

Raw_Evidence_Span: DyTmYbLu (1860 °C HP) ... β ... Dy0.26Tm0.26Yb0.24Lu0.24
the corresponding hot-pressed bulk material are pure single-phase β-(Dy0.25Tm0.25Yb0.25Lu0.25)2Si2O7 solid solutions

Phase_Composition.Note: Pure single-phase β-type solid solution, hot-pressed bulk

Process_Text.original: The bulk sample was fabricated via hot-pressing sintering method at 1860 °C under 30 MPa in a BN-coated graphite mold.
Process_Text.simplified: Hot pressing at 1860 °C under 30 MPa in BN-coated graphite mold.

Structure_Text.original: The hot-pressed bulk material is pure single-phase β-(Dy0.25Tm0.25Yb0.25Lu0.25)2Si2O7 solid solution. SEM-EDS point analysis gave the atomic ratio Dy:Tm:Yb:Lu nearly 1:1:1:1.
Structure_Text.simplified: Pure single-phase β-type bulk material with homogeneous RE distribution (Dy0.26Tm0.26Yb0.24Lu0.24).

Raw_Evidence_Span: the powders synthesized at 1550 °C contain dual-phase mixture of β-type solid solution as major phase, together with a decent amount of γ-type solid solution
β-phase accounts for 61.15 wt% in the mixture, whereas the γ-phase accounts for 38.85 wt%

Process_Text.original: RE oxides and SiO2 powders mixed according to the stoichiometry of (Dy0.25Ho0.25Yb0.25Lu0.25)2Si2O7, ball milled 24 h, dried at 60 °C for 24 h, sieved through 120 mesh, pressure-less synthesis at 1550 °C for 6 h.
Process_Text.simplified: Stoichiometric oxide mixture, 24 h ball milling, 60 °C/24 h drying, 120-mesh sieved, pressure-less synthesis at 1550 °C/6 h.

Structure_Text.original: The powders synthesized at 1550 °C contain dual-phase mixture of β-type solid solution as major phase, together with a decent amount of γ-type solid solution. Quantitative phase analysis based on the Rietveld method shows β-phase accounts for 61.15 wt% and γ-phase accounts for 38.85 wt%.
Structure_Text.simplified: Dual-phase β + γ mixture at 1550 °C: β = 61.15 wt%, γ = 38.85 wt%.

Raw_Evidence_Span: Fabricating the sample via hot-pressing sintering method at 1650 °C results in decreased amount of β-phase down to 33.16 wt%, compensated by increased amount of γ-phase up to 66.84 wt%
DyHoYbLu (1650 °C HP) ... β or γ ... Dy0.27Ho0.26Yb0.25Lu0.22

Composition.Note: SEM-EDS for both β and γ phases gave Dy0.27Ho0.26Yb0.25Lu0.22 (Table 1). TEM-EDS mapping confirmed homogeneous RE distribution at atomic scale in both β and γ lattices.

Process_Text.original: Fabricated via hot-pressing sintering method at 1650 °C under 30 MPa in a BN-coated graphite mold. Characterized by XRD, SEM-EDS, and aberration-corrected STEM.
Process_Text.simplified: Hot pressing at 1650 °C under 30 MPa; characterized by XRD, SEM-EDS, and aberration-corrected STEM.

Equipment.Note: double aberration-corrected; HAADF-STEM; equipped with EDS for atomic-resolution mapping

Structure_Text.original: Fabricating the sample via hot-pressing sintering method at 1650 °C results in decreased amount of β-phase down to 33.16 wt%, compensated by increased amount of γ-phase up to 66.84 wt%. Both β-phase and γ-phase exhibit homogeneous RE elemental distributions. Aberration-corrected STEM resolved phase 1 as β-(Dy0.25Ho0.25Yb0.25Lu0.25)2Si2O7 in [112] zone axis and phase 2 as γ-(Dy0.25Ho0.25Yb0.25Lu0.25)2Si2O7 in [100] zone axis.
Structure_Text.simplified: 1650 °C hot-pressed bulk: β = 33.16 wt%, γ = 66.84 wt%. Both phases have homogeneous RE distribution confirmed by SEM-EDS and STEM-HAADF/EDS.

Properties.Note: Rietveld refinement of XRD, 1650 °C hot-pressed bulk
Rietveld refinement of XRD, 1650 °C hot-pressed bulk

Process_Text.original: RE oxides and SiO2 mixed stoichiometrically, ball milled 24 h, pressure-less synthesis at 1550 °C for 6 h.

Process_Text.original: Hot-pressed at 1860 °C under 30 MPa in a BN-coated graphite mold.

Structure_Text.original: The small amount of β-phase is completely eliminated after hot-pressed at 1860 °C, due to the β→γ polymorphic transformation.
Structure_Text.simplified: Single-phase γ after β→γ transformation at 1860 °C.

Raw_Evidence_Span: as-synthesized powders contain G-phase in 72.60 wt% and β-phase in 27.40 wt%
obvious elemental segregation ... β-phase is enriched with Yb and Lu ... G-phase is enriched with La and Ce

Phase_Composition.Note: Indexed to G-Ce2Si2O7 (PDF#48-0058), enriched with La and Ce

Stoichiometry.Note: Designed equimolar composition cannot form homogeneous solid solution; severe elemental segregation occurs

Process_Text.original: RE oxides and SiO2 mixed stoichiometrically, pressure-less synthesis at 1550 °C for 6 h.

Structure_Text.original: Both the as-synthesized powders and the hot-pressed bulk material are mixtures of β-type and G-type disilicates. As-synthesized powders: G-phase 72.60 wt%, β-phase 27.40 wt%. SEM-EDS shows obvious elemental segregation: β-phase enriched with Yb and Lu, G-phase enriched with La and Ce.
Structure_Text.simplified: Mixed β + G phases with elemental segregation: G = 72.60 wt%, β = 27.40 wt%.

Raw_Evidence_Span: phase composition remains almost unchanged after hot-pressed at 1650 °C for 2 h (G-phase in 72.15 wt% and β-phase in 27.85 wt%)
SEM-EDS analysis shows obvious elemental segregation in both phases

Composition.Note: SEM-EDS (Table 1): β-phase RE ratio La0.05Ce0.06Yb0.43Lu0.46; G-phase RE ratio La0.35Ce0.35Yb0.16Lu0.14

Process_Text.original: Hot-pressed at 1650 °C for 2 h under 30 MPa in a BN-coated graphite mold.
Process_Text.simplified: Hot pressing at 1650 °C for 2 h under 30 MPa.

Structure_Text.original: Phase composition remains almost unchanged after hot-pressed at 1650 °C for 2 h: G-phase 72.15 wt%, β-phase 27.85 wt%. SEM-EDS shows obvious elemental segregation: β-phase enriched with Yb and Lu, G-phase enriched with La and Ce.
Structure_Text.simplified: Phase composition unchanged: G = 72.15 wt%, β = 27.85 wt%. Strong elemental segregation.

Raw_Evidence_Span: DFT calculations is performed using the Vienna Ab Initio Simulation Package (VASP)

Process_Text.original: DFT calculations performed using VASP with PAW method, PBE-GGA functional, 600 eV plane-wave cutoff, Γ-centered Monkhorst-Pack k-mesh at 2π × 0.03 Å⁻¹. Supercells with 88 lattice sites, 558 unique configurations for β-type. Configuration ensembles generated using ATAT SQS code.
Process_Text.simplified: VASP-PAW-PBE DFT with 600 eV cutoff, 88-site supercells, 558 β-type configurations via ATAT SQS.

Simulation_Text.original: Configuration ensembles generated using ATAT SQS code. DFT calculations performed using VASP with PAW method, PBE-GGA functional, 600 eV plane-wave cutoff, Gamma-centered Monkhorst-Pack k-mesh at 2pi x 0.03 A^-1. Full relaxation of lattice parameters and internal atomic positions.
Simulation_Text.simplified: VASP-PAW-PBE DFT with 600 eV cutoff, full geometry relaxation.

Structure_Text.original: β-type ensemble with randomized occupations of Dy, Tm, Yb, Lu on RE sublattice.
Structure_Text.simplified: β-type configurational ensemble for DFT mixing-energy analysis.
